quitConfirmation.title: Quit Stave
quitConfirmation.message: Are you sure you want to quit?
quitConfirmation.detail: Any running tasks will be stopped and unsaved changes may be lost.

unsavedChanges.title: Changes have not been saved
unsavedChanges.message: Stave could not save your latest workspace changes or Tars draft.
unsavedChanges.detail: Keep Stave open to preserve your current work, or retry saving before quitting.

rendererRecovery.unresponsive: The Stave conversation window is not responding.
rendererRecovery.detail: Reload to restore saved work. Recent changes that were not saved may be lost. Running tasks may continue in the background; check their activity after reloading before starting another run. Reloading does not resend your request.

remoteControlMobile.title: Stave remote control
remoteControlMobile.risk: This connection is not encrypted. Use it only on a trusted private network or VPN.
remoteControlMobile.pairHint: Enter the code shown in Stave under Settings > Integrations > Remote control. A code works once and expires after five minutes.
remoteControlMobile.pairFailed: That code is invalid or expired. Create a new one in Stave.
remoteControlMobile.pairLocked: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
remoteControlMobile.deviceLimit: Too many devices are paired. Revoke one in Stave first.
remoteControlMobile.requestsEmpty: Nothing is waiting for an answer.
remoteControlMobile.resultExpired: This request was already answered or is no longer waiting.
remoteControlMobile.resultInvalid: Stave could not find this request, or it can only be answered on the desktop.
remoteControlMobile.resultUnavailable: Stave did not receive it. Check that the desktop app is open, then try again.
remoteControlMobile.desktopUnavailable: The Stave desktop window is not open, so status is unavailable.
remoteControlMobile.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment before refreshing.
remoteControlMobile.signedOut: This device is no longer paired. Pair it again.
